note: Each timing row covers approximately two seconds. Tick can run multiple simulation steps. VM includes collision. CPU render time includes submission/waits; no GPU execution timer is available.
fallback_note: Reason counters may include offscreen cache activity; they are not mutually exclusive rejected-frame counts.
percentile_note: Worst per-interval p99, not the p99 of the complete scene and not an average-of-slowest-1-percent FPS.
memory_note: Excludes native C allocations, allocator metadata, VRAM and fragmentation.
